title: What happened in South Korea from 1800 to 1914?
question: What happened in South Korea from 1800 to 1914?
claim: The 10 best-documented records TIMEWISE holds for South Korea from 1800 to 1914, out of 16, in date order.
why: Records whose home country is South Korea, dated from 1800 to 1914, ranked by how many Wikipedia language editions describe them. They are not joined by statements: this is a tour of what is best documented, not an argument that one led to the next.
